tableDescription: Customers table. Customer (a person) = `customers.customer_unique_id`. The column `customer_id` is created per order, so counting it counts orders, not unique people.

columnDescriptions.customer_id: Per-order key; join to `orders.customer_id`. Do NOT count this for unique customers.
columnDescriptions.customer_unique_id: Unique person identifier. Always count `customer_unique_id` for customer/people counts.

tableDescription: Order line items. Sales/sold: items on orders where `orders.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')`. Sales amount = `order_items.price` (freight is NOT sales).

columnDescriptions.price: Item sales price. Sales amount = `price` (freight_value is NOT sales).

tableDescription: Order payments. Order payment value = `SUM(payment_value)` for the order. One order can have multiple payment rows. NEVER join `order_payments` to `order_items` directly.
Order reviews. If an order has multiple reviews, use the most recent one (`ORDER BY review_creation_date::timestamp DESC`).

columnDescriptions.review_creation_date: Review date (stored as text; cast to `::timestamp`).

tableDescription: Orders table. Sales and 'sold' exclude `order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')`. Delivered = `order_status = 'delivered'`. Late = `order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp > order_estimated_delivery_date::timestamp`. Delivery time = days from `order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp` to `order_delivered_customer_date::timestamp`. Date columns are stored as text; cast to timestamps (e.g. `::timestamp`) before date comparisons.

columnDescriptions.order_status: Order status ('delivered', 'shipped', 'canceled', 'unavailable'). Sales exclude canceled and unavailable.
columnDescriptions.order_purchase_timestamp: Purchase timestamp (stored as text; cast to `::timestamp`).
columnDescriptions.order_delivered_customer_date: Delivery timestamp (stored as text; cast to `::timestamp`).
columnDescriptions.order_estimated_delivery_date: Estimated delivery timestamp (stored as text; cast to `::timestamp`).

tableDescription: Translation mapping between Portuguese `product_category_name` and English `product_category_name_english`.

Products table. Category: English name from `product_category_name_translation.product_category_name_english`. If no translation, use `product_category_name`. Products with NULL category are ignored for category questions.
